title: Inventory SwissKnife authority and information flows

authority.statement: SwissKnife owns presentation, intent projection, confirmation interaction, and evidence display. Browser-authored allow/deny, consent, tenant, and dry-run fields are not production admission authority. Host policy and admission remain outside TypeScript UI code.

source_binding.binding_rule: Exact committed SwissKnife gitlink in the controller worktree; dirty checkouts are not authority.
source_binding.evidence_observation: read-only inventory against exact gitlink; no browser/network execution

authority_edges.title: Governed desktop invoke defaults consent to granted
authority_edges.risk: Legacy default-granted consent for mutative desktop controls constructs browser-side confirmation without a host-issued admission outcome.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Paired governed invokes that differ only by omitting consent must not synthesize consent=granted; default must be absent/denied pending host confirmation.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Remove default-granted consent; browser may project confirmation intent only; host admission supplies allow/deny.

authority_edges.title: Desktop gateway constructs allow policy_decision locally
authority_edges.flow: browser consent field -> local policy_decision.outcome allow/deny -> AllAppToolGateway
authority_edges.risk: Browser-local policy constructor can emit allow without host policy evaluation or exact-argument admission binding.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Requests differing only in browser-authored policy_decision.outcome must produce identical host authorization inputs; browser allow must not grant authority.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Delete browser policy_decision constructor; consume host-issued typed decision bound to method/resource/argument digest.

authority_edges.title: Agent Supervisor gateway synthesizes console policy locally
authority_edges.quote: Browser-safe mediated request is permitted by the console policy.
authority_edges.risk: Console-local allow reason treats mediated browser requests as permitted by UI policy rather than host admission.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Injected confirmation_token alone must not change host admission digest/result; console policyFor allow is a failing seed.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Replace policyFor synthesis with host-issued decision projection; keep only shape validation and redaction.

authority_edges.title: confirmation_token maps to consent granted without host lease
authority_edges.risk: UI confirmation token is treated as consent grant; FACP requires host-issued outcomes and absent default consent.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Presence/absence of confirmation_token must not itself authorize effects; consent default remains absent until host decision.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Treat confirmation_token as review-intent projection only; host maps confirmation to admission separately.

authority_edges.title: App capability gateway accepts caller-supplied policy_decision
authority_edges.risk: Optional caller policy_decision can carry permit/deny metadata across the browser/host boundary without proving host authorship.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Caller-supplied permit must not enable execution; only host-authored decision CIDs/outcomes are admissible.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Reject browser-authored policy_decision fields; accept only host admission projection references.

authority_edges.title: Mediated invocation forwards caller dry_run into host-bound policy bag
authority_edges.flow: browser dry_run flag -> resolveMediatedInvocation input.policy.dry_run -> host mediator dispatch
authority_edges.risk: Browser can project dry_run=false with locally allowed policy; live projection must be host-gated, not UI-selected.

negative_test_seed.oracle: dry_run=false from browser must not upgrade evidence class or bypass confirmation; host decides live admission.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep dry_run as request intent only; host admission binds live vs dry-run and returns typed outcome.
removal_or_adaptation_target.adaptation: preserve field as projection, strip authority meaning

authority_edges.title: UI declares governed actions dry-run by default
authority_edges.quote: Governed actions are dry-run by default.
authority_edges.flow: desktop panel copy/control -> VirtualDesktopLiveGateway dry_run default
authority_edges.risk: Presentation default is desirable but not host proof; must not be confused with admission authority.

negative_test_seed.oracle: UI dry-run default text/control must not be accepted as production live qualification evidence.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Retain dry-run-default UX; bind live enablement exclusively to host-issued outcomes displayed with argument digest.

authority_edges.title: Host mediator dispatches only after consent/dry-run gate
authority_edges.risk: Host gate still trusts browser-provided consent/dry_run bits; correct ownership is host, but inputs remain untrusted.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Mutating dispatch with browser consent=granted and dry_run=false must fail closed without host admission token.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Adapt mediator to require host admission token/decision CID; stop treating browser consent as sufficient.

authority_edges.title: Forbidden browser surfaces enumerate non-authority boundaries
authority_edges.flow: browser console contract -> forbidden surfaces list -> bundle audit expectations
authority_edges.risk: Contract forbids direct host effects but does not by itself prevent browser-constructed policy on mediated paths.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Browser payloads requesting host_process_launch or host_state_file_read must remain denied/unavailable.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep forbidden surfaces; extend negatives to browser policy/consent fields.

authority_edges.title: Azure tenantId collected in browser api-keys form without host tenant binding
authority_edges.flow: browser api-keys form tenantId/clientSecret fields -> local credential UX (tool path policy_blocked)
authority_edges.risk: Tenant-like selector exists as a credential field, not as a host-bound tenant admission dimension; portfolio cross-tenant hyperproperties lack an explicit SwissKnife selector edge.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Changing browser tenantId alone must not alter host authorization; missing host tenant binding remains an explicit gap.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Do not promote browser tenantId to authority; introduce host-issued tenant/scope binding if multi-tenant dispatch is required.

authority_edges.title: UIIR refuses to encode permissions as UI visibility authority
authority_edges.flow: descriptor permissions -> UIIR codec lossy drop -> presentation IR without authz
authority_edges.risk: Positive separation to preserve; regressions that reintroduce permission-as-visibility would recreate browser authority.

negative_test_seed.oracle: UIIR encode/decode must not resurrect permissions as enabled/visible authority.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep lossy separation; seed regression vectors in browser-nonauthority suite.

authority_edges.title: MCP dashboard marks host daemon commands non-executable in browser
authority_edges.flow: dashboard host command record -> browserExecutable=false -> UI disclaimer only
authority_edges.risk: Host command text must remain non-authority; any browser execution path would violate ownership.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Host daemon command entries must never become browserExecutable or spawn process APIs in web builds.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep classification; ensure migration does not reclassify host commands as browser remotes.

sensitive_flow_edges.title: Tool gateway rejects host_path and credential keys from browser payloads
sensitive_flow_edges.flow: browser payload -> forbiddenBrowserPayloadPath -> invalid_input before dispatch
sensitive_flow_edges.risk: Boundary is necessary but must stay fail-closed; missing keys or nested smuggling would leak host paths/secrets.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Payloads containing host_path/file_path/api_key/secret must be rejected before owner dispatch.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Retain and strengthen nested/canonicalized key rejection; never transmit raw credential/host path.

sensitive_flow_edges.title: Prompt steering redacts prompt text in logs
sensitive_flow_edges.flow: prompt steering request -> redactAgentSupervisorPromptSteeringForLog -> display/log projection
sensitive_flow_edges.risk: Public evidence must not contain raw prompt/secret content; redaction marker is presentation-only.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Log/receipt projections for prompt steering must not embed raw prompt text when redaction mode is required.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep redaction; bind declassification explicitly if any prompt substring must appear in evidence.

sensitive_flow_edges.title: Legacy web AI adapter stores and transmits secret key from localStorage
sensitive_flow_edges.flow: localStorage goose_secret_key -> AI adapter headers -> localhost backend
sensitive_flow_edges.risk: Browser-held secret key can flow on requests outside mediated host admission and redaction policy.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Migrated paths must not read goose_secret_key from localStorage or attach X-Secret-Key outside host-mediated credential handling.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Remove or isolate legacy adapter from mediated FCA paths; forbid raw secret header emission from browser bundles.

sensitive_flow_edges.title: Backend status contract forbids exposing host paths and credentials
sensitive_flow_edges.flow: backend status projection -> browser_safety flags/patterns -> UI status panel
sensitive_flow_edges.risk: Status leakage of backend_url/api_key/host_path would violate browser nonauthority and secret hyperproperties.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Backend status payloads containing host_path/api_key/localhost URLs must fail validation.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep fail-closed status projection; extend vectors for nested secret fields.

sensitive_flow_edges.title: Host mediator rejects forbidden browser payload keys before adapter invoke
sensitive_flow_edges.risk: Second boundary after gateway; both must remain; bypassing either reintroduces credential/path flow.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Mediator must fail closed on authorization/host_path/secret keys even if gateway is skipped.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep dual boundary; do not weaken either side during migration.

sensitive_flow_edges.title: Desktop governed controls default dry_run true while consent defaults granted
sensitive_flow_edges.flow: governed binding -> dryRun default true + consent default granted -> mediated request
sensitive_flow_edges.risk: Dry-run default mitigates live effect locally but pairs with default-granted consent; mixed trust must be split in FCA migration.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Even with dry_run default true, consent must not default to granted; live flip must require host admission.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Keep dry-run-default; remove granted consent default; host decides live upgrade.

missing_rights.title: package.json license field is empty while README claims AGPL and LICENSE.md is absent
missing_rights.summary: SwissKnife declares an empty package license, README points at AGPL via LICENSE.md, and LICENSE.md is missing from the exact gitlink. Mechanical rights clearance is forbidden.

missing_artifacts.note: README links to LICENSE.md but the file is not present at the bound commit.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Inventory must not infer SPDX clearance or compatibility from empty package license or missing LICENSE.md.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: Human legal review must supply RightsIR/SPDX; do not machine-clear from README prose.

missing_rights.title: No host-bound tenant selection edge on mediated browser-to-host dispatch
missing_rights.summary: Evidence subset requires tenant selection inventory. Exact tree exposes Azure tenantId as a browser credential field and blocks api-keys tool dispatch, but does not provide a host-issued tenant/scope admission binding for mediated tool calls.

declarations.note: Credential form field only; not host tenant admission.

negative_test_seed.oracle: Absence of host tenant binding must remain an explicit gap; inventory must not treat missing tenant controls as satisfied.

removal_or_adaptation_target.action: If multi-tenant effects are required, add host-issued tenant/scope binding; until then keep gap explicit.

adaptation_disposition.for_facp_029: Seed browser-nonauthority paired tests from SK-AUTH-001..005 and SK-SENS-003; default-granted and browser-constructed allow are failing seeds, not accepted evidence.
adaptation_disposition.for_facp_030: Migrate mediated paths to host-issued FCA outcomes; browser sends no authority decision; default consent absent; UI displays exact argument digest.
